203:             for (&k, v) in split_result.iter().zip(&positional) {
204:                 record.push(v, Value::string(k, head));

206:         }
207:         vec![Value::record(record, head)]

218:                         dst_span: head,
219:                         src_span: span,

part.text:
The full test suite passes (1369 passed, 0 failed; the two plugin stress-test failures in an earlier run were flaky and pass on re-run).

Changes in `crates/nu-command/src/strings/split/column.rs`:
- Added `-n`/`--number` flag (`SyntaxShape::Int`, "Split into maximum number of columns") to the signature (column.rs:28)
- Reads the flag in both `run` and `run_const` and passes it through `Arguments` to `split_column_helper`
- Uses `regex.splitn(s, max_split)` when `--number` is given, so the nth column contains the remainder — matching `split row` behavior; without the flag, behavior is unchanged
- Added a doc example: `'a--b--c' | split column -n 2 '--'`

Verified manually that `'1.2.3.4 server server.domain.tld alias' | split column -n 2 -r '\s+'` yields `column1: 1.2.3.4`, `column2: server server.domain.tld alias`, and existing usage (no flag, named columns, `--collapse-empty`) is unaffected.
